statement: Unproved conjecture in (Z/16Z)[[q]]: for Andrews's 18-colored generalized Frobenius partition function, sum_{m>=0} cphi_18(6m+1) q^m is congruent to 4*f_2*f_3^2/(f_1*f_6), equivalently 4*sum_{k in Z} q^{k(3k-1)/2}. The Jacobi-triple-product equality of the two right-hand expressions and their absence of exponents 3 or 4 modulo 5 are proved; the left-to-right congruence is not proved. Exact supporting computation covers 0<=m<=504, with 0<=m<=99 used for discovery and 100<=m<=504 held out.
contribution: The proposed identity is a stronger structural refinement of the frozen pair of modulo-16 congruences: it predicts every coefficient in the full 6n+1 section modulo 16 by a unary theta series and would imply both original progressions immediately. Two structurally independent left-side generators and two right-side generators agree on the stated exact range, and a fourteen-summand audit isolates a smaller formal-dissection proof kernel. No all-orders proof or priority claim is made.
